description: A connection string contract defines per-service, per-environment database connection parameters with no embedded credentials, proper SSL enforcement, and isolated identities for each service.

rules.description: The spec must declare environments, services, and format (uri or dsn). Missing these makes the contract incomplete.

No connection string may contain a literal password value. All credentials must reference an environment variable placeholder (${DB_PASSWORD}) or vault path ({{vault:secret/db}}). Embedded passwords in URIs (postgres://user:pass@host) are also rejected.
For all non-local environments, sslmode must be require, verify-full, or verify-ca. disable and prefer allow plaintext connections and are vulnerable to MITM attacks.
Every service must have a host or connection_string declared for every environment in the spec. A missing host causes silent fallback to a wrong database.
No two services may share the same database user for the same environment. Shared credentials mean a breach of one service exposes all others.
connect_timeout must be declared globally or per environment. Without it, applications hang indefinitely when the database is unreachable, causing cascading failures.
All connection strings must use the same format (all URI or all DSN). Mixed formats cause inconsistent parsing behavior across services.
